主要内容: The Walt Disney Company approved the terms of the 2002 Executive Performance Plan, as amended, at its annual meeting of shareholders on March 6, 2013. The amendment eliminates the aggregate limit on bonuses awarded to executives covered by the plan and imposes a limit of $27.5 million for the chief executive officer, executive chairman, president, and chief operating officer, and a limit of $10 million for all other covered officers. The changes were part of the company's broader compensation strategy and were filed with the Proxy Statement for the 2013 Annual Meeting and incorporated by reference as Exhibit 10.1 to the report. The amendment reflects the company's approach to executive compensation and its alignment with shareholder interests.
